private: Private: nobody but your team sees this notebook. Nothing is ever shown on your site.
quickHelp: A few words are enough, for example “Video editing tutorial”. The rest can come later.
added: Noted: “{title}”. You can fill it in whenever you like.
errTitleEmpty: Write at least a few words, for example “Video editing tutorial”.
errTitleLong: This title is too long ({max} characters at most). Keep the essentials here: details go in the notes.
errFull: The notebook is full ({max} ideas). Delete some old archived ideas to make room.
empty_idea: No ideas here yet. Use the big button above whenever an idea comes to you.
empty_doing: Nothing is in progress. Open an idea and put it here when you start working on it.
empty_published: Nothing is published yet. Put an idea here once it is out: the notebook keeps the date.
empty_archived: No archived ideas. Archiving sets an idea aside without losing it.
emptyAll: Your notebook is empty for now. Use the big button above: a title is enough, the rest can come later.
emptySearch: Nothing matches. Try a single word, or other words.
ideaGone: This idea no longer exists. Here is the list.
searchHelp: In titles, sentences, notes, networks and steps. Accents and capital letters do not matter.
byAssistant: Written down by the AI assistant.
lateIdea: The target date has passed. That is fine: change it (in “When and where?”) or clear it, whenever you like.
archivedNote: This idea is archived: it no longer shows in the other places, but it is not lost. Choose another place below to bring it back.
noSteps: This idea has no steps. You can write some in the “The idea” card, at the bottom of this page.
targetHelp: Optional. It is a guide for you, not a duty: you can change or clear it at any time.
otherHelp: Separated by commas, for example: Newsletter, Podcast.
errDate: Choose a day that exists, for example {example}.
errNetworkLong: “{name}” is too long ({max} characters at most). Write only the name of the network, for example “Newsletter”.
errNetworks: {max} networks at most per idea. Keep the most important ones.
summaryHelp: What will this video, article or post be about?
notesHelp: Anything that comes to mind: outline, links, remarks.
stepsHelp: One step per line ({max} at most). A removed step disappears; a renamed step starts unticked again.
errSummaryLong: One sentence is enough ({max} characters at most). The rest can go in the notes.
errNotesLong: These notes are too long ({max} characters at most). Keep the essentials.
errStepLong: A step is too long ({max} characters at most): “{step}…”. Write it in a few words, for example “Shoot the video”.
errSteps: {max} steps at most per idea. Group a few together.
deleteText: This idea is archived: it is not in anyone's way. If you will never use it again, you can erase it for good.
deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” for good? The idea, its steps and its notes will be erased and cannot be brought back. If you are unsure, leave it in the archive.
deleted: The idea is deleted for good.
errDeleteFirst: Archive this idea first: only archived ideas can be deleted for good.
errGone: This idea no longer exists. Go back to the list.
errChanged: This idea changed in the meantime. Reload the page, then try again.
errGeneric: That did not work. Reload the page, then try again.
rhythmStart: Your rhythm: {every}. As soon as you put an idea in “Published”, the notebook will follow your rhythm for you.
rhythmOk: Your rhythm: {every}. Last publication: {date}. You are right on rhythm.
rhythmBehind: Your rhythm: {every}. Your last publication was {days} days ago ({date}). That is fine, it happens to everyone. {next}
rhythmPause: Your rhythm: {every}. There has been a break since {date}, and that is perfectly normal. Pick it up at your own pace. {next} If the rhythm is too tight right now, you can change it in the “Settings” tab.
hintDoing: “{title}” is already in progress: ticking a single step today is already moving forward.
hintPick: Pick an idea from your list and put it in “In progress”.
hintAdd: Write down an idea with the big button: a title is enough.
lateOne: One idea has a target date that has passed. No rush: change the date whenever you like.
lateMany: {n} ideas have a target date that has passed. No rush: change the dates whenever you like.
copyText: The file opens in a spreadsheet (up to {max} ideas). The site backup also keeps your notebook, in a file you can read without installing anything.
mdCut: The rest was cut: the file was getting too long. Use the notebook's CSV download.
